$comment: One sentence per hint per tool, for the portal's justification fields. Each entry states the VALUE it justifies beside the sentence; `pnpm submission` reads the live catalogue and refuses to build if a live hint differs from the value written here, so a sentence can never justify a hint the server no longer declares. The MCP annotation classes are owned by @shipstatic/mcp (vocabulary.ts); this file explains them to a reviewer and owns nothing else.

readOnlyHint.why: Creates a new deployment from the files the user provides and publishes it at a fresh URL.

openWorldHint.why: Publishes content to a publicly reachable shipstatic.com URL, which is public internet state.

destructiveHint.why: Only adds a new deployment; it never overwrites or removes an existing one, and an anonymous deployment simply expires.

readOnlyHint.why: Lists the connected account's deployments and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the public ShipStatic hosting platform, whose deployments are public internet state; the read itself changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns one deployment's details and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the public ShipStatic hosting platform, whose deployments are public internet state; the read itself changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves a record only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Replaces the labels on one of the connected account's deployments.

openWorldHint.why: Writes to the public ShipStatic hosting platform; labels are private account metadata and the served site is unchanged.

destructiveHint.why: Changes organisational labels only; the deployment and its files are untouched and the labels can be set again.

readOnlyHint.why: Removes a deployment and its files from the connected account.

openWorldHint.why: Takes a publicly reachable site offline, which changes public internet state.

destructiveHint.why: Permanently deletes the deployment and its files with no recovery; the tool description requires the model to confirm with the user first.

readOnlyHint.why: Creates a custom domain record or points an existing one at a different deployment in the connected account.

openWorldHint.why: Changes which site a public hostname serves once the user's DNS points at ShipStatic, which is public internet state.

destructiveHint.why: Adds or re-points a domain; the previous deployment still exists and the domain can be pointed back.

readOnlyHint.why: Lists the connected account's domains and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the public ShipStatic hosting platform, whose domains serve public sites; the read itself changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns one domain's details and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the public ShipStatic hosting platform, whose domains serve public sites; the read itself changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves a record only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns the DNS records the user must configure at their DNS provider and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the public ShipStatic hosting platform; the records describe public DNS the user configures elsewhere, and the read changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves records only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Looks up which DNS provider serves a domain and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Queries public DNS for the domain's provider; the lookup changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves a lookup result only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns a shareable link to the domain's DNS setup page and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the public ShipStatic hosting platform; the link opens a public setup page and the read changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves a link only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Checks whether a domain name is valid and available and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the public ShipStatic hosting platform to answer availability; the check changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves a verdict only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.

readOnlyHint.why: Queues a DNS verification for the domain, which can move it to verified and start serving the linked site.

openWorldHint.why: A successful verification puts the site live on the user's public hostname, which is public internet state.

destructiveHint.why: Only checks DNS the user configured and activates the domain; nothing is deleted or overwritten.

readOnlyHint.why: Removes a custom domain from the connected account.

openWorldHint.why: Stops the public hostname from serving the site, which changes public internet state.

destructiveHint.why: Permanently deletes the domain record; the tool description requires the model to confirm with the user first.

readOnlyHint.why: Returns the connected account's email, plan and usage and changes nothing.

openWorldHint.why: Reads from the public ShipStatic hosting platform; the account read changes nothing.

destructiveHint.why: Retrieves account details only; nothing is deleted, overwritten or revoked.
